run_offline_gym_random: generate samples from a random policy on a Gym environment and save results to a pickle file
run_offline_gym_predictor: generate samples from a trained predictor policy on a Gym environment and save results to a pickle file
run_timeline_operator: load a pandas pickle file, convert to PySpark, and upload the dataframe to Hive via the timeline operator
run_evaluate_gym: evaluate a trained model on a Gym environment over N episodes and assert average reward passes a score bar
run_make_agent_from_model: create an agent from a published TorchScript model by loading the latest model from a FileSystemPublisher
